mentions.name: Mobility Data
mentions.description: A Rails app that renders a large set of the author's Strava activity data all at once, exposing GIS and mobility-related data relevant to the traffic junction work.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've got rather a lot of GIS/mobility-related data available here. It's just a rails app that renders a bunch of my strava activity data all at once: https://josh.works/mobility-data
